config_entries.label: Enable Spreadcycle
config_entries.description: `true` uses SpreadCycle chopper mode, `false` uses StealthChop. StealthChop is quieter, SpreadCycle gives more torque at higher speeds.

config_entries.label: Interpolation
config_entries.description: Interpolate each step to 256 microsteps, for smoother and quieter movement at low microstep settings.

config_entries.label: Inverse Direction
config_entries.description: Reverse the direction of the motor.

config_entries.label: Microsteps
config_entries.description: The number of microsteps per full step. One of `1`, `2`, `4`, `8`, `16`, `32`, `64`, `128` or `256`.

config_entries.label: Tpwm Threshold
config_entries.description: The `TPWMTHRS` value, `0` to `1048575`. When StealthChop is used, the driver switches to SpreadCycle above the speed set by this value. `0` disables the switch. See the datasheet for the conversion between this value and speed.
